stage: V0.11-D4-A1R1 TW same-caliber recalculation prereg (FROZEN before first aggregate)
motivation: Manuscript claims frozen detectors applied unchanged across corpora, while RQ2/limitations disclose that the external (Open-SWE) side uses path-aware command normalization (tool path appended to view/open/str_replace_editor/create command strings before cnorm/csim grouping) and the discovery (Thoughtworks) side does not. This recalculation unifies the normalization caliber on the discovery side for the four repetition shapes.
plan: Input: TW discovery corpus sessions.parquet (pin below), 15000 sessions, unchanged from D3-E1/E3 censuses.

Detector: A0-frozen E1/E2/E3/E14 rules exactly as implemented in evidence/tools/v011_d4a1_census.py (A0 freeze commit 1865a160): E1 = groups of >=2 events sharing identical normalized first command line; E2 = groups of >=2 events sharing identical digit-normalized command; E3 = >=2 events sharing the same structured path; E14 = reread event whose same-path predecessor is within 3 event positions.

Normalization caliber (the single experimental variable): apply the D4-A1 path-aware rule verbatim - when a tool call carries a path and its command first token is in {view, open, str_replace_editor, create}, append the path to the command string before norm_cmd/sim_cmd.

Schema adapter (corpus-specific, unchanged by this recalculation): Thoughtworks message schema loader from v011_d3e3_repeat_class_census.py (assistant tool_calls_json with command/path arguments, code-fence fallback, user-role OBSERVATION capture). The adapter is required by the TW schema and is not part of the caliber under test.
Denominator: all 15000 corpus rows, matching D3-E1 census accounting.

Comparison: per-shape session incidence on TW under unified caliber vs (a) original TW D3-E1 incidences, (b) Open-SWE D4-A1 incidences; replication band function identical to D4-A1 (ratio 0.5-2.0 REPLICATED).
No other shape is recomputed; no detector definition, threshold, or dataset is modified; canonical results remain untouched.
